description: API Standard 2000 7th Edition (2014/R2020) screening factors for normal thermal venting and fire emergency environment factor. Liquid movement multipliers and fire heat flux follow §3.3 / §3.4 SI forms used in this app.

liquidMovement.notes: Nm³/h free air per m³/h liquid (§3.3.1 screening form).

volatility.label: Flash point < 37.8 °C (100 °F)
volatility.notes: API 2000 Table 1 volatile / low flash class — Y applied on thermal outbreathing.

volatility.label: Flash point ≥ 37.8 °C (100 °F)
volatility.notes: Higher flash / less volatile thermal outbreathing factor.

volatility.label: Hexane-like / highly volatile
volatility.notes: Treated as low-flash volatile class for Y screening.

fire.notes: Q = 43.2·A_wett^0.82·F (kW, A in m²). V_emer = (Q/Lv)·√(70.6/M)·1234 (Nm³/h free air).
